description: Silver content and melt value of US junk silver coins by face value: 90% (pre-1965 dimes, quarters, halves), 40% (1965-1970 Kennedy halves or Eisenhower dollars) or 35% (1942-1945 war nickels). For 90% coins it also shows the 0.715 oz worn-coin figure and today's lowest dealer ask per $1 face.

coin_type.description: 90 = 90% silver; 40 = 40% Kennedy halves; 40_eisenhower = 40% Eisenhower dollars; 35 = 35% war nickels.

face_value.description: Total face value in US dollars, for example 10 for $10 face.

title: Junk silver melt calculator
